description: This file defines an Angular service 'MetricsService' that fetches KPI, chart, and table data for a dashboard. It includes mock data generation and real API fetching logic, with internal state management using RxJS BehaviorSubjects.

classes.name: MetricsService
classes.description: Angular service for fetching and managing dashboard metrics data, supporting mock and real API modes.

methods.name: getKpis
methods.description: Returns an observable of KPI data with loading/error states.

methods.name: getChartData
methods.description: Returns an observable of chart data with loading/error states.

methods.name: getTableData
methods.description: Returns an observable of table data with loading/error states.

methods.name: loadKpis
methods.description: Loads KPI data, either mock or from API, updating internal state.

methods.name: loadChart
methods.description: Loads chart data, either mock or from API, updating internal state.

methods.name: loadTable
methods.description: Loads table data, either mock or from API, updating internal state.

methods.name: fetchJson
methods.description: Fetches JSON data from API endpoint with simulated delay.

methods.name: normalizeUrl
methods.description: Constructs full URL from base and path.
